Final Offers Invited on or Before Friday, 25th September. REA Seamus Carthy are finalising the sale of a traditional-style, two-storey, 3-bedroom family home, featuring a substantial outbuilding measuring c. 260 sq.m all set on c. 19 acres of land fronting onto the River Suck, complete with additional commonage. Situated in a highly attractive and picturesque setting within close proximity to the village of Athleague, this property offers exceptional potential given its select location. The residence itself is beautifully positioned on the grounds and will substantially benefit from refurbishment, while the extensive outbuilding offers obvious potential for a variety of uses. The c. 19 acres of land completely surround the house and provide direct access onto the river. Considered a rare opportunity, flexible lotting options are available to suit market demand, meaning the house can be sold on c. 2 acres with the remaining lands sold in separate lots. Immediate enquiries and final offers are invited on or before Friday, 25th September

Final Offers - Friday 25th September

Residential accommodation comprises feature entrance hallway, sitting Room, kitchen and Dining Room, W.C at ground floor with 3 no. bedrooms, office and a Bathroom at first floor. Externally, we have a large outbuilding measuring approximately 260 sq.m. 
 Private Water Supply, Septic Tank System 
 This property offers an exceptional combination of natural beauty, practical space, and local convenience. Externally, the standout feature is its extensive direct frontage onto the River Suck, which is highly renowned for premium coarse and trout fishing, offering immediate access for angling, boating, and scenic recreation. The c. 19 acres of land are further enhanced by additional commonage rights, providing a rare and valuable asset for agricultural or leisure use. Furthermore, the substantial c. 260 sq.m outbuilding provides extensive space suitable for storage, a workshop, or potential conversion projects. In terms of location, the traditional 3-bedroom family home is nestled in a picturesque setting within close proximity to Athleague Village, ensuring easy access to local shops, traditional pubs, a grocery store, a community center, and a primary school. Additionally, the property sits just a short drive from Roscommon Town, placing major supermarkets, secondary schools, a hospital, and the local train station within seamless reach for everyday family living.
The property is located at Parkmore, Athleague, Co. Roscommon (Eircode: F42 AE27). It sits in a scenic countryside setting bordering the River Suck, just a short distance from Athleague Village
